goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: Not complete. T009 credibly closes terminal decisions, pre-ack reconnect, replacement references, backlog pruning, reload handling, and durable export; the current 120-test, typecheck, audit, diff, and artifact gates pass. However openSvg checks pending only before awaiting /api/svg, then mutates selected file, currentFile, dirty state, and the artboard before AgentSession.open rechecks pending. An agent transaction arriving during that fetch can leave the old session/review pending while the visible document switches—the orphaned-review defect T009 was required to close. Tests cover synchronous session replacement, and the browser note covers clicking after pending, not this race.

evidence.finding: Independent read-only verification passed: npm run typecheck and npm run test reported 10 files and 120 tests passing; npm audit --audit-level=high reported zero vulnerabilities; git diff --check passed.

src/client/agent/transport.ts and src/server/agent-transport.ts implement exact-origin accepted/reverted decisions, idempotent terminal convergence, cached staging, acknowledgement-gated event cursors, authoritative-subscriber requeue, active-event pruning, and bounded terminal records. Real HTTP/Vite regression tests cover duplicate/conflicting decisions and receive-before-ack recovery.

T006, T008, and T009 receipts map the public logo-designer adapter through authenticated HTTP, Vite, SSE, detached SvgEditor staging, accessible review, accept/revert, undo/redo, manual refinement, targeted adjustment, and responsive keyboard QA without CORS or editor-internal bypass.

docs/oracle/artifacts/T009-final.svg independently reproduced SHA-256 9780ec8650c8255cac66e4579bf97388d2876dad5c186105cd34f67146463f56 and 1,406 bytes. Structural assertions found all expected original and introduced resources, fill #14b8a6, and no reserved protocol/review metadata; tests/logo-designer-adapter.test.ts deterministically checks the same artifact.

src/client/main.ts:659-665 checks pending and then awaits the SVG request. After the await, lines 680-708 change file selection, currentFile, dirty state, and replace the artboard. Only at lines 710-713 does AgentSession.open reject a newly pending transaction. The function returns with the old editor/session/review still authoritative but a different visible SVG and file state, so accept/revert can act against a detached old document.

tests/agent-history.test.ts:124-142 proves only synchronous AgentSession.open rejection. docs/oracle/T009-release-remediation.md records buttons disabled once review is pending, but neither evidence delays an already-started /api/svg response, stages a transaction during that delay, and verifies that no document/UI/session mutation commits afterward.

T005 preserves its blocked receipt and is explicitly resolved_by T008, whose completed receipt supplies the missing real-browser review verification. No earlier required Worker remains unresolved; this newly discovered T010 lifecycle package is the sole completion blocker.

Real-browser confirmation that the pending review remains attached to the original visible document during the delayed response, then accept/revert and a subsequent file switch behave normally.
